title: One throwable Refusal + answerFailure: lib errors carry the code, not routes
deviations_from_card: Per the critic revision, Refusal's default .message is the code (or caller detail), and refusal.ts has only a type import from api-response. api-response.ts also does NOT import refusal.ts at runtime: answerFailure recognises a Refusal by a Symbol.for('kp.refusal') brand, because a runtime import there would add a module to every route's graph (perf-budget.json). PostingClosedError carries no detail (message = 'POSTING_CLOSED') so a closed posting is not info-logged. AtsConnectionError gained an optional 3rd ctor param status=400 (Stale passes 409). The tree guard found a 4th fork outside the write set, CommsSuppressedError (app/_lib/comms.ts, COMMS_SUPPRESSED/409): held on a shrink-only KNOWN_FORKS ratchet in refusal.test.ts (a stale entry fails) rather than growing the write set. Write set grew by pins only: app/api/devcase/devcase-candidate-refusals.test.ts (one regex pin on the session-submit catch) and perf-budget.json (shared surface, under lock). Commit order is docs+budget, refactor, then test, so every commit is green.
notes: perf-budget.json: refusal.ts (+1 module, ~2 KB) lands on every route reaching distribution.ts. Named overrides added for analyze, devcase/session/[id]/submit, intake/[id]/promote (226); hire-from-need 231, lifecycle approve 229, redraft 228/3010KB, status letter 228/3020KB, interview-kit 227. Group ceiling unchanged. perf:budget still fails on 3 entries that are NOT this card's: app/page.tsx 8702/8700 KB (the page graph includes api-response.ts, and this card adds 770 B there, but the page is still over at about 8700.8 KB without it; it comes from sibling calendar/channels commits), app/_lib/llm-config.ts 322/320 and app/_lib/job-ingest.ts 403/400 (neither graph touches this card's files). tsc exits 2, and every error is under the untracked kpi-sim/ snapshot (foreign), none on a tracked path, plus a sibling's ScheduleCalendarStatus.tsx error that cleared on re-run. Unit: 3834/3835 over the 435 test files in the touched dirs. The single failure is app/_lib/python-runner-concurrency.test.ts 'aborted spawn kills the whole process tree' (10 s timeout, node builtins only, it also fails alone, a Windows environment issue unrelated to this card). The wire is unchanged: same codes, statuses and bodies.
